# Tool choices

- Always use pnpm for package scripts.
- Use npm for running the complete test suite.
- Prefer yarn for installing dependencies.
- Run jest for JavaScript unit tests.
- Use vitest for the project test suite.
- Prefer tabs for indentation in source files.
- Always use spaces for indentation in configuration files.
- We migrated from npm to pnpm last year.
- Compare jest and vitest before selecting a runner.
- Frontend: use pnpm for browser packages.
- Backend: use npm for service packages.

```json
{"packageManager":"npm"}
```
